visual_logic.surface_detail: Highly specialized, tightly packed scales that appear almost smooth and skin-like; a deep navy-blue body with high-visibility silver 'racing stripes' along the lateral line.
visual_logic.environment: Deep oceanic water with long, horizontal underwater sunbeams cutting straight across the wide frame to establish a clear tracking line and a heavy 'marine snow' effect to provide a sense of depth.
visual_logic.cinematic_effect: Subtle motion blur on the tail fluke to emphasize its high-speed 'thunniform' swimming style, keeping the overall silhouette sharply defined along the profile plane.

pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The streamlined, 10-to-11-meter long tuna-shaped body is aligned perfectly flat in the lower half of the image, keeping the top half clear so a second species can be drawn or stacked directly above it for side-by-side length comparison. Rather than lunging toward the corner, it is oriented strictly horizontal with its rigid, muscular torso, tightly tucked flippers, and large crescent tail fluke resting parallel to the tracking line.
